evidence: Sorting by Priority yields order: Review project proposal(High), Complete tax filing(High), Submit final report(High), Schedule dentist appointment(Medium), Buy groceries(Low)

Active view sorted by Deadline: Tomorrow, Aug 27, Aug 30, Sep 1, Sep 8 ascending. Completed view sorted by deadline: Tomorrow(dated) before null-deadline "Organize desk", confirming undated tasks sort after dated ones.

issue: Edit button fully disabled for blocked tasks instead of allowing partial edit
actual: For blocked task "Complete tax filing" (id 4), the Edit button has the disabled attribute and cannot be clicked at all (Playwright click times out: 'element is not enabled'). There is no alternate inline control to modify description or priority. Users cannot change description/priority on a blocked task, contrary to the requirement that only title/deadline should be locked while description/priority remain editable.

evidence: Created task "Simple new task FT4" with title only; active count increased from 5 to 6 and task appears in active list.

Created "FT5 Full Detail Task" with description "This is a test description for FT5.", deadline Sep 15, High priority, prerequisite "Schedule dentist appointment". All values persisted and displayed correctly, including blocked-warning referencing the prerequisite.

Edited unblocked task: changed title, description, deadline, priority, and added a prerequisite - all changes persisted (task became blocked showing new prerequisite warning). Then deleted the task; it disappeared from the list and active count decreased from 7 to 6.
Marked "Buy groceries" (unblocked active task) complete: it left the active list (Active 6→5) and appeared in Completed view (Completed 2→3).

Active toggle shows only active-state tasks with "Active 5" count; Completed toggle shows only completed tasks (Reply to client emails, Buy groceries, Organize desk) with "Completed 3" count. Views are mutually exclusive and counts match toggle labels/tasks.summary.

Assigned "Schedule dentist appointment" as prerequisite when creating "FT5 Full Detail Task" and "Buy groceries" when editing another task - both saved tasks became blocked and displayed the correct prerequisite name in their warning, confirming dependency state persisted.

Tasks with incomplete prerequisites (id 4, 7, FT5 task) show complete.state="blocked", complete toggle enabled=false, and a blocked-warning label. Unblocked tasks (id 1,2) have no such warning and complete.enabled is not false.
Task 4 with one incomplete prerequisite shows: 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'. Task 7 with two incomplete prerequisites shows: '2 prerequisites incomplete'.

Task 4/7 complete toggle disabled while prerequisites incomplete. After completing prerequisite "Review project proposal", task 4 became active/eligible and was successfully completed. After completing task 4, task 7 (which depended on both) became active with "2 prerequisites completed" and its complete toggle became enabled.

Set up chain: task 7 depends on FT5, FT5 depends on task 2 (Schedule dentist appointment). When editing task 2's prerequisites, both FT5 (direct cycle) and task 7 (indirect cycle) are absent from the selectable options list, leaving only non-cycle-forming tasks (1,3,4,5,6).
Entering whitespace-only text ("   ") into the title field kept the Create Task submit button disabled. Cancelling left task counts unchanged (Active 3, Completed 5) and no new task was added.

Completed tasks remain visible and retrievable in Completed view (5 completed tasks listed with all details). Reopening "Buy groceries" from Completed view via its complete toggle moved it back to Active (Active 3→4, Completed 5→4), confirming completion is reversible and non-destructive.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves its completed dependent task simultaneously completed and blocked
actual: Created CS22-A (depends on CS22-B), completed CS22-B then CS22-A. Reopened CS22-B via its complete toggle (no warning/prevention shown, reopen succeeded). After reopening, CS22-A remained in the Completed view with complete toggle state="completed", yet simultaneously displayed blocked-warning 'Prerequisite "CS22-B Prereq Task" incomplete' and complete.enabled=false. The system neither prevented the prerequisite reopen nor reverted the dependent task to an incomplete state, leaving it in an invalid completed+blocked state.

evidence: Hovering the blocked-warning of "FT5 Full Detail Task" shows tooltip 'Dependency Chain: Schedule dentist appointment - pending'. Hovering "Submit final report"'s warning (indirect chain) shows full chain: Review project proposal (done), Complete tax filing (done), FT5 Full Detail Task (pending), Schedule dentist appointment (pending) - correctly identifying pending prerequisites.

issue: No visual dashed-line connection between dependent tasks exists in the UI
actual: Inspected the DOM for connecting elements (SVG lines/paths spanning between task cards, canvas elements, or dashed-line connectors). Only 2 elements use "border-dashed" and both are the outer card border of blocked task items themselves (a dashed border framing the whole card), not a line connecting a dependent task to its prerequisite task. No SVG line/path or canvas draws a line between two task cards. The only dependency-chain affordance present is the text "blocked-warning" label with its hover tooltip (verified separately under IX-20); there is no distinct hoverable visual connector between the two task elements as required.

evidence: Every task card shows title and priority badge (e.g. "Review project proposal" / High). Description and deadline render only when supplied (e.g. "CS22-B Prereq Task" shows no description/deadline paragraph since none was entered, while other tasks show both). Blocked tasks expose a prerequisite warning label. Completed task titles get a "line-through text-muted-foreground" CSS class distinguishing them visually from active tasks (no strikethrough), in addition to being segregated into the Completed view.
